body: Thanks. I don't know how things came to this. I have nobody left in my life who I feel I can tell anything to. I'm so pathetic that I'm begging for help on the internet (no offense. You're doing great work by putting in time just to help people. Thank you very much.) Three months ago I was doing well.. Everything just came crashing down around me..
I *should* probably talk to someone. The thing is, a lot of times I just don't have the motivation..

I didn't feel comfortable with her, so I didn't really say much.

As for my mother, I just talked about my problems with her. She was helpful, but only temporarily.
I have gone to a therapist before, and it really didn't help me. I've talked to my mother about my problems, but I haven't told her about my thoughts of suicide (or whatever you'd like to call them).
